text:
Alex: Quick question for the room — what's the weirdest 'just in case' thing you keep around? I found a tiny sewing kit in my backpack and now I'm wondering who else is hoarding oddities.
Maya: A single, mysteriously unlabeled USB drive in my kitchen junk drawer. No idea what's on it. :thinking_face:
Diego: @Maya open it in a VM or it's probably cursed. :rofl:
Sam: A roll of duct tape plus a tiny baggie of safety pins. For... emergencies?
Rina: A small plastic dinosaur. From 2002. I keep it on my desk for morale.
Alex: @Rina love that. I also have an emergency spoon in my bag (for health shake emergencies).
Maya: I have an unopened pack of glow sticks. No parties planned, but they feel like safety equipment.
Diego: Old hotel keycard with a room number I don't remember. Nostalgia + potential treasure map.
Sam: ops-bot: ping — what does oncall recommend keeping "just in case"?
ops-bot: ops-bot: On-call checklist: phone charger, spare laptop charger, emergency snacks, spare headphones. Also duct tape. :thumbsup:
Rina: @Sam aha, our tastes align with ops. Duct tape = universal problem solver.
Alex: Best answer so far: duct tape, spare charger, and a tiny dinosaur. New survival pack idea.
Maya: Survey time — pick one: duct tape, glow sticks, mystery USB, or tiny dinosaur? Vote with emoji.
Diego: :one: for duct tape
Sam: :two: glow sticks
Rina: :four: tiny dinosaur
Alex: :one: duct tape (obvious winner)
Maya: Results so far: duct tape is undefeated. Thanks for indulging my curiosity — I will retire the tiny sewing kit to the official emergency drawer. :grin:
